senses.en: a short summary of a research paper or report
senses.pattern: write an abstract / submit an abstract / read the abstract / the abstract of a paper
senses.example: Before reading the whole paper, she checked the [[abstract]] to see whether it was relevant to her research.
senses.example_zh: 在讀整篇論文之前，她先看了摘要，確認內容是否與自己的研究有關。
senses.note: 指論文、報告開頭的內容摘要

senses.en: acting with great energy and determination to succeed
senses.pattern: aggressive marketing / an aggressive sales strategy / an aggressive campaign
senses.example: The company launched an [[aggressive]] marketing campaign to win more young customers before the holiday season.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司推出強勢的行銷活動，要在假期前贏得更多年輕顧客。

senses.en: (of a disease) developing or spreading very quickly
senses.pattern: an aggressive cancer / an aggressive tumor / an aggressive form of the disease
senses.example: Doctors found that she had an [[aggressive]] form of cancer and began treatment immediately.
senses.example_zh: 醫師發現她罹患的是一種惡化快速的癌症，便立刻開始治療。

senses.en: a single object or item, especially one of a set
senses.pattern: an article of clothing / household articles / personal articles / articles of value
senses.example: Passengers are reminded not to leave any personal [[articles]] on the train when they get off.
senses.example_zh: 提醒乘客下車時不要把任何個人物品留在列車上。
senses.note: an article of clothing＝一件衣物

senses.en: a numbered section of a law or agreement
senses.pattern: Article 5 of the treaty / under Article 12 / the articles of the contract
senses.example: According to [[Article]] 12 of the agreement, either side may end the contract with a month's notice.
senses.example_zh: 依照協議第十二條，任何一方只要提前一個月通知就能終止合約。

senses.en: only just; succeeding, but with great difficulty
senses.pattern: barely pass the test / barely survive / barely escape / barely make it
senses.example: Our team [[barely]] won the final, scoring the winning goal in the very last minute.
senses.example_zh: 我們隊在最後一分鐘才踢進致勝球，勉強贏得決賽。
senses.note: 表示「勉強做到」，結果是肯定的

senses.en: only a very short time before; no more than
senses.pattern: had barely arrived when / barely a week later / barely 18 years old
senses.example: She had [[barely]] sat down at her desk when the fire alarm started to ring.
senses.example_zh: 她才剛在書桌前坐下，火災警報器就響了起來。

senses.en: a hard hit; a sudden shock or disappointment
senses.pattern: a heavy blow to / deal a blow to / a blow to one's confidence / soften the blow
senses.example: Losing the school's best pitcher to injury was a serious [[blow]] to the baseball team.
senses.example_zh: 學校最好的投手因傷缺陣，對棒球隊是一大打擊。

senses.en: to waste a chance or spoil something by a mistake
senses.pattern: blow a chance / blow an interview / blow it
senses.example: He [[blew]] his chance of getting the job by arriving thirty minutes late for the interview.
senses.example_zh: 他面試遲到三十分鐘，搞砸了得到那份工作的機會。

gsat.sentence: Peter’s sudden death was a great [[blow]] to Jane and it took her a long time to get over the grief.

senses.en: a group of people who share the same opinion
senses.pattern: the rival camp / the opposing camp / be divided into two camps
senses.example: After the debate, even students in the rival [[camp]] admitted that her argument was convincing.
senses.example_zh: 辯論結束後，就連敵對陣營的學生也承認她的論點很有說服力。

senses.en: a way of sending information or getting something done
senses.pattern: through official channels / the proper channels / channels of communication / a sales channel
senses.example: Complaints about school lunches should be made through the proper [[channels]], not on social media.
senses.example_zh: 對學校午餐的申訴應該透過正式管道提出，而不是發在社群媒體上。

senses.en: to direct money, energy, or feelings toward a purpose
senses.pattern: channel energy into / channel anger into / channel funds into
senses.example: The coach taught the boy to [[channel]] his anger into training harder on the field.
senses.example_zh: 教練教那個男孩把怒氣投注於球場上更刻苦的訓練。

senses.en: a passage of water that ships can travel along
senses.pattern: a deep channel / a shipping channel / a narrow channel / the English Channel
senses.example: Large ships must follow a narrow [[channel]] to enter the harbor safely at low tide.
senses.example_zh: 退潮時，大型船隻必須沿著狹窄的水道才能安全進港。

gsat.sentence: The pilot is needed to direct large ships into a port, where there are often deep water [[channels]] surrounded by shallower seabeds.
When the [[channel]] is not deep enough.

senses.en: a set of rules about how people should behave
senses.pattern: a code of conduct / a dress code / a moral code / a code of ethics
senses.example: The school's [[code]] of conduct clearly states that cheating on tests will not be tolerated.
senses.example_zh: 該校的行為準則明訂，考試作弊絕不寬貸。

senses.en: a set of official laws or regulations
senses.pattern: the building code / a fire safety code / the civil code / the tax code
senses.example: The old theater was closed because it failed to meet the city's fire safety [[code]].
senses.example_zh: 這家老戲院因不符合該市的消防安全法規而關閉。

gsat.sentence: Many employees don’t like a conservative dress [[code]].
Supporters of casual office wear also argue that a casual dress [[code]] helps them save money.

senses.en: to formally arrange and agree on a treaty or deal
senses.pattern: conclude a treaty / conclude an agreement / conclude a deal / conclude a contract
senses.example: After months of talks, the two countries finally [[concluded]] a trade agreement last week.
senses.example_zh: 經過數月談判，兩國終於在上週締結貿易協定。
senses.note: 不是「結束協議」，而是「談成、簽訂」

senses.en: to be important or have value
senses.pattern: every vote counts / what counts is / it is the thought that counts / count for little
senses.example: In a job interview, first impressions [[count]], so dress neatly and arrive on time.
senses.example_zh: 求職面試時第一印象很重要，所以要穿著整齊並準時到場。

senses.en: to consider someone or something to be something
senses.pattern: count oneself lucky / count him as a friend / be counted among the best
senses.example: I [[count]] myself lucky to have had such patient teachers throughout high school.
senses.example_zh: 高中三年都遇到這麼有耐心的老師，我認為自己很幸運。

senses.en: completely; exactly
senses.pattern: dead right / dead tired / dead serious / stop dead
senses.example: You were [[dead]] right about the weather; it started pouring just after we left.
senses.example_zh: 關於天氣你說得完全正確；我們一出門就下起了傾盆大雨。
senses.note: 口語用法，置於形容詞或副詞前

senses.en: (of a machine or battery) no longer working or having power
senses.pattern: a dead battery / the phone went dead / the line is dead
senses.example: My phone battery was [[dead]], so I couldn't call my parents to pick me up.
senses.example_zh: 我的手機電池沒電了，所以沒辦法打電話請爸媽來接我。

senses.en: to take away part of someone's pay or points
senses.pattern: dock someone's pay / dock wages / dock points from a score
senses.example: Workers who arrive late more than three times a month will have their pay [[docked]].
senses.example_zh: 一個月遲到超過三次的員工會被扣減薪水。

senses.en: (of a spacecraft) to join with another in space
senses.pattern: dock with the space station / dock successfully / a docking system
senses.example: The spacecraft successfully [[docked]] with the space station, delivering food and equipment to the crew.
senses.example_zh: 太空船成功與太空站對接，為組員送來食物和設備。
senses.note: 原義為「（船）靠碼頭」，引申到太空船

senses.en: to make something happen; to bring about
senses.pattern: effect a change / effect a cure / effect a recovery / effect a reform
senses.example: The new principal hopes to [[effect]] real change in how students are evaluated.
senses.example_zh: 新校長希望在學生評量方式上促成真正的改變。

senses.en: the things that belong to a person
senses.pattern: personal effects / household effects / collect one's effects
senses.example: After the flood, families returned to collect whatever personal [[effects]] they could still find.
senses.example_zh: 洪水過後，家家戶戶回去收拾還找得到的個人財物。

senses.en: to make a hidden crime or dishonest act public
senses.pattern: expose a scandal / expose corruption / expose a fraud / expose the truth
senses.example: The young reporter [[exposed]] a factory that had been secretly dumping waste into the river.
senses.example_zh: 這名年輕記者揭發了一家偷偷把廢棄物排入河中的工廠。

senses.en: to give someone the chance to experience something new
senses.pattern: expose students to new ideas / expose children to music / be exposed to a language
senses.example: The exchange program [[exposes]] students to different cultures and ways of thinking.
senses.example_zh: 這項交換計畫讓學生接觸不同的文化與思考方式。
senses.note: 常用被動 be exposed to；名詞 exposure

gsat.sentence: The more one is [[exposed]] to the English-speaking environment, the better he or she will learn the language.
But it’s the parents’ job to serve a variety of foods and [[expose]] their children to healthy dieting habits.

senses.en: belonging to the same group or sharing the same situation
senses.pattern: fellow students / fellow passengers / fellow citizens / fellow workers
senses.example: When the bus broke down, she chatted with her [[fellow]] passengers while waiting for help.
senses.example_zh: 公車拋錨時，她一邊等待救援，一邊和同車的乘客聊天。

senses.en: a person in the same group or situation as you
senses.pattern: play with one's fellows / be respected by one's fellows / cooperate with one's fellows
senses.example: Young children learn how to share and take turns by playing with their [[fellows]].
senses.example_zh: 幼童藉由和同伴玩耍，學會分享與輪流。
senses.note: 常用複數；另指大學研究員（research fellow）

gsat.sentence: In teaching young players to cooperate with their [[fellows]] on the practice field, the game shows them the necessity of teamwork in society.

senses.en: strange and not familiar to someone
senses.pattern: be foreign to someone / a foreign concept / feel completely foreign
senses.example: Mountain life was [[foreign]] to the city children, who had never seen a night sky full of stars.
senses.example_zh: 山上的生活對這群城市孩子來說很陌生，他們從沒看過滿天星斗的夜空。

senses.en: having entered something by accident and not belonging there
senses.pattern: a foreign object / a foreign body / foreign matter / a foreign substance
senses.example: Tears help wash away dust and other [[foreign]] objects that get into our eyes.
senses.example_zh: 眼淚有助於沖走跑進眼睛的灰塵和其他外來的異物。

gsat.sentence: Without much contact with the outside world for many years, John found many technological inventions [[foreign]] to him.

senses.en: considering; taking something into account
senses.pattern: given the circumstances / given his age / given the fact that / given that
senses.example: [[Given]] the heavy rain, the school decided to cancel the outdoor concert this afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 鑑於雨勢很大，學校決定取消今天下午的戶外音樂會。

senses.en: particular; already fixed or stated
senses.pattern: at any given time / on any given day / a given period / a given situation
senses.example: At any [[given]] moment, thousands of planes are flying in the skies around the world.
senses.example_zh: 在任何一個特定的時刻，全球天空中都有數千架飛機在飛行。
senses.note: 只放在名詞前，不是「被給的」

gsat.sentence: But [[given]] that Christmas is just a few weeks away, here is a gift idea.
[[Given]] the variations in preferences, new studies have started to untangle the benefits and risks of horror movies.

senses.en: to have enough space for a number or amount
senses.pattern: hold 500 people / hold two liters of water / hold a large audience
senses.example: The new school auditorium can [[hold]] up to eight hundred students and teachers.
senses.example_zh: 新的學校禮堂最多可容納八百名師生。

senses.en: to have a particular belief or opinion
senses.pattern: hold that / hold the view that / hold strong opinions / be held responsible
senses.example: Many experts [[hold]] that reading for pleasure is the best way to build vocabulary.
senses.example_zh: 許多專家認為，為樂趣而閱讀是累積字彙的最好方法。
senses.note: 常接 that 子句；三態 hold–held–held

senses.en: to remain true or valid; to stay unchanged
senses.pattern: hold true / hold good / the rule still holds / if the weather holds
senses.example: The old saying that practice makes perfect still [[holds]] true for language learners today.
senses.example_zh: 「熟能生巧」這句老話，對今日的語言學習者依然適用。

gsat.sentence: But does this [[hold]] true across time and cultures?
From Turkey, she boarded a small boat that [[held]] 20 people and set sail into the deep waters of the Aegean Sea.

senses.en: the act of bringing something into use for the first time
senses.pattern: the introduction of new technology / since its introduction / the introduction of a new system
senses.example: The [[introduction]] of electronic textbooks has made students' schoolbags much lighter than before.
senses.example_zh: 電子教科書的引進，讓學生的書包比以前輕了許多。
senses.note: 動詞 introduce 亦有「引進」之義

senses.en: a book or course that explains a subject to beginners
senses.pattern: an introduction to psychology / a good introduction to / a brief introduction to
senses.example: This short book is an excellent [[introduction]] to astronomy for curious teenagers.
senses.example_zh: 這本小書是絕佳的天文學入門書，很適合好奇的青少年。
senses.note: 常用 an introduction to＋學科

gsat.sentence: Since its [[introduction]] in the early 20th century, the headgear has saved countless lives and is considered the number one safety tool for construction workers.

senses.en: to find out a piece of news or information
senses.pattern: learn of the news / learn about the accident / learn that / be sorry to learn
senses.example: We were shocked to [[learn]] that our favorite teacher would retire at the end of June.
senses.example_zh: 得知我們最喜歡的老師將在六月底退休，大家都很震驚。
senses.note: learn of / about＋名詞；learn that＋子句

gsat.sentence: I’ve just [[learned]] that I’ll die very soon and I’m going to be reborn as a pig.

senses.en: to keep saying that something is true
senses.pattern: maintain that / maintain one's innocence / have always maintained that
senses.example: Despite the evidence against him, the driver [[maintained]] that he had not run the red light.
senses.example_zh: 儘管證據對他不利，那名駕駛仍堅稱自己沒有闖紅燈。

senses.en: a place where coal or metals are dug; a hidden bomb
senses.pattern: a coal mine / a gold mine / work in a mine / a land mine
senses.example: His grandfather worked in a coal [[mine]] for thirty years before the town switched to tourism.
senses.example_zh: 在小鎮轉型發展觀光之前，他的祖父在煤礦坑工作了三十年。

senses.en: to dig coal, gold, etc. out of the ground
senses.pattern: mine coal / mine gold / mine the area for copper
senses.example: Gold has been [[mined]] in these mountains since the late nineteenth century.
senses.example_zh: 自十九世紀末以來，這片山區就一直有人開採黃金。

gsat.sentence: During the second Industrial Age, people toiled at unusual hours in [[mines]] or factories and often had to get up for work early in the morning.

senses.en: to come closer to something in time or space
senses.pattern: be nearing completion / be nearing the end / near retirement age / as the deadline nears
senses.example: As the exam [[neared]], the library stayed crowded until closing time every night.
senses.example_zh: 隨著考試逼近，圖書館每晚都擠滿了人，直到閉館。

senses.en: almost happening or almost being something
senses.pattern: a near disaster / a near miss / in near darkness / a near impossibility
senses.example: The two planes came within meters of each other in a [[near]] disaster over the airport.
senses.example_zh: 兩架飛機在機場上空相距僅數公尺，差一點釀成災難。

gsat.sentence: After several years of physical suffering and [[near]] financial ruin from the medical costs, the couple began questioning the treatment after consulting with other patients in online support groups.

senses.en: honest and not keeping your feelings secret
senses.pattern: be open with someone / be open about one's feelings / open and honest
senses.example: Teenagers are more [[open]] with their parents when they feel listened to rather than judged.
senses.example_zh: 當青少年覺得父母是在傾聽而非批判時，會對父母更坦率。
senses.note: be open with＋人；be open about＋事

senses.en: not yet decided or answered
senses.pattern: an open question / leave the matter open / remain open
senses.example: Whether robots will ever replace human teachers remains an [[open]] question.
senses.example_zh: 機器人是否終將取代人類教師，仍是個懸而未決的問題。
senses.note: be open to＝願意接受；容易受到

senses.en: to leave someone; to separate from each other
senses.pattern: part from someone / part as friends / part at the station / part on good terms
senses.example: The two old friends [[parted]] at the station, promising to meet again next summer.
senses.example_zh: 這兩位老朋友在車站分別，約定明年夏天再相聚。

senses.en: a role played by an actor in a play or film
senses.pattern: play the part of / get a part in / the leading part
senses.example: She was thrilled to get the [[part]] of the queen in the school's spring play.
senses.example_zh: 她在學校的春季戲劇中得到皇后這個角色，興奮不已。
senses.note: play a part in 亦指「在…中起作用」

senses.en: how high or low a sound or voice is
senses.pattern: a high pitch / rise in pitch / perfect pitch / the pitch of a note
senses.example: Her voice rose in [[pitch]] as she grew more and more excited about the news.
senses.example_zh: 她對這個消息越來越興奮，聲音的音調也跟著升高。
senses.note: 英式英語另指「（足球）球場」

senses.en: to set up a tent or a camp
senses.pattern: pitch a tent / pitch camp / pitch a tent by the river
senses.example: We [[pitched]] our tent beside the lake just before the sun went down.
senses.example_zh: 我們趕在太陽下山前，在湖邊搭起了帳篷。

gsat.sentence: On October 27, 1915, Shackleton ordered his crew to abandon the ship, [[pitching]] tents on the ice a mile and a half away.
He had a glassmaker create thirty-seven hemispheres made of glass, with each being a different size and thickness to produce different [[pitches]].

senses.en: to supply the energy that makes something work
senses.pattern: be powered by electricity / power a car / power a machine / solar-powered
senses.example: The lights on this campus are [[powered]] entirely by solar panels on the rooftops.
senses.example_zh: 這座校園的電燈完全由屋頂上的太陽能板提供動力。
senses.note: 常用被動 be powered by

senses.en: a country with great influence in the world
senses.pattern: a world power / a major power / an economic power / a sea power
senses.example: By the 1700s, the small trading nation had grown into a major sea [[power]] in Europe.
senses.example_zh: 到了十八世紀，這個以貿易立國的小國已成為歐洲的海上強國。

gsat.sentence: The invention of the steam engine, which was used to [[power]] heavy machines, brought about a revolutionary change in society.

senses.en: itself; in the strict sense (used after a noun)
senses.pattern: the city proper / the test proper / the meeting proper
senses.example: The welcome speech lasted so long that the concert [[proper]] did not begin until nine.
senses.example_zh: 歡迎致詞拖得太久，音樂會本身直到九點才開始。

senses.en: real; good enough to be called by that name
senses.pattern: a proper meal / a proper job / a proper holiday / a proper bed
senses.example: After a week of instant noodles, the hikers were eager for a [[proper]] meal.
senses.example_zh: 吃了一星期的泡麵後，這群登山客很想吃一頓像樣的飯。
senses.note: 此義多見於英式英語，只放在名詞前

senses.en: to ask customers to return a faulty product
senses.pattern: recall a product / recall faulty cars / be recalled for safety reasons
senses.example: The company [[recalled]] thousands of baby strollers after several children were injured.
senses.example_zh: 在數名孩童受傷後，該公司召回了數千台嬰兒推車。

senses.en: the ability to remember things you have learned or experienced
senses.pattern: powers of recall / total recall / have excellent recall
senses.example: Actors with excellent [[recall]] can memorize pages of lines in a single evening.
senses.example_zh: 記憶力絕佳的演員，一個晚上就能背下好幾頁台詞。

gsat.sentence: My grandfather has astonishing powers of [[recall]]. He can still vividly describe his first day at school as a child.

senses.en: to be someone's responsibility; to depend on something
senses.pattern: rest with the principal / the decision rests with / rest on evidence / success rests on
senses.example: The final decision on the school trip [[rests]] with the principal, not the teachers.
senses.example_zh: 校外教學的最終決定權在於校長，而不是老師。

senses.en: to support something by putting it on something else
senses.pattern: rest one's head on / rest one's elbows on / rest a ladder against the wall
senses.example: Tired from the long hike, she [[rested]] her head on her backpack and closed her eyes.
senses.example_zh: 走了很久的山路累壞了，她把頭靠在背包上，閉上眼睛。

senses.en: except; apart from
senses.pattern: save for / all save one / empty save for
senses.example: The streets were empty [[save]] for a few stray cats searching for food.
senses.example_zh: 除了幾隻在覓食的流浪貓之外，街上空蕩蕩的。
senses.note: 正式、文學用語；常作 save for

senses.en: to prevent someone from having to do something
senses.pattern: save someone the trouble / save someone a trip / save someone from having to
senses.example: Booking tickets online will [[save]] you the trouble of waiting in a long line.
senses.example_zh: 上網訂票可以省去你大排長龍的麻煩。

senses.en: the punishment that a court gives to a criminal
senses.pattern: a prison sentence / a life sentence / serve a sentence / a light sentence
senses.example: The thief received a two-year prison [[sentence]] for breaking into several homes.
senses.example_zh: 這名竊賊因闖入多戶民宅，被判處兩年徒刑。

senses.en: to officially state a criminal's punishment in court
senses.pattern: be sentenced to five years / sentence someone to death / be sentenced to life in prison
senses.example: The judge [[sentenced]] the driver to six months in prison for causing the accident.
senses.example_zh: 法官判處肇事駕駛六個月有期徒刑。
senses.note: 常用被動 be sentenced to＋刑期

gsat.sentence: Tuck kills the man and is jailed and [[sentenced]] to be executed.

senses.en: only; just; for no other reason than
senses.pattern: simply because / simply a matter of / simply by doing
senses.example: Many students skip breakfast [[simply]] because they would rather sleep ten more minutes.
senses.example_zh: 許多學生不吃早餐，只不過是因為寧願多睡十分鐘。

senses.en: used to emphasize how strong a statement is
senses.pattern: simply amazing / simply wonderful / simply cannot / simply not true
senses.example: The view from the mountaintop at sunrise was [[simply]] breathtaking.
senses.example_zh: 日出時從山頂望出去的景色簡直美得令人屏息。
senses.note: 與否定連用：simply cannot＝實在無法

gsat.sentence: Music was moving out of the relatively small halls of Mozart’s day into the large concert halls of the 19th century, and without amplification, the glass armonica [[simply]] couldn’t be heard.
Capoeiristas learned to camouflage the forbidden fights with singing, clapping, and dancing as though it were [[simply]] entertainment.

senses.en: sensible and able to be trusted
senses.pattern: sound advice / sound judgment / sound evidence / a sound investment
senses.example: A good scientist's conclusions must be based on [[sound]] evidence, not on personal feelings.
senses.example_zh: 優秀科學家的結論必須以可靠的證據為依據，而不是個人感受。

senses.en: in good condition; not damaged or ill
senses.pattern: structurally sound / safe and sound / of sound mind / a sound heart
senses.example: Engineers checked the bridge after the earthquake and declared it structurally [[sound]].
senses.example_zh: 地震過後，工程師檢查了這座橋，宣布其結構完好。

senses.en: to send someone to a place to work or keep guard
senses.pattern: be stationed in Europe / be stationed at the gate / station guards / station troops
senses.example: Volunteers were [[stationed]] at every exit to guide visitors out of the stadium.
senses.example_zh: 每個出口都派駐了志工，引導觀眾離開體育場。
senses.note: 常用被動 be stationed in／at

gsat.sentence: A police officer was [[stationed]] by the side to operate the system.
After the Second World War, a great number of American soldiers were [[stationed]] in Europe.

senses.en: having the stated number of people or members
senses.pattern: a crowd 5,000 strong / a 50-strong team / an army 10,000 strong
senses.example: A crowd ten thousand [[strong]] gathered in the square to welcome the returning athletes.
senses.example_zh: 多達一萬人的群眾聚集在廣場上，歡迎運動員凱旋歸來。
senses.note: 置於數字之後，如 a 50-strong team

senses.en: (of money or an economy) having a high value
senses.pattern: a strong dollar / a strong currency / a strong economy
senses.example: A [[strong]] dollar makes American goods more expensive for buyers in other countries.
senses.example_zh: 強勢的美元使美國商品對其他國家的買家來說變得更貴。

senses.en: to make or change something to suit a particular need
senses.pattern: tailor a course to students' needs / be tailored to / be tailored for beginners
senses.example: The travel agency [[tailors]] every tour to the budget and interests of its customers.
senses.example_zh: 這家旅行社依照顧客的預算與興趣，為他們量身打造每一趟行程。

senses.en: a word or name that shows someone's rank or job
senses.pattern: the title of professor / a job title / hold the title of / a royal title
senses.example: She was given the [[title]] of professor after twenty years of teaching and research.
senses.example_zh: 她從事教學與研究二十年後，獲得了教授的頭銜。

senses.en: the position of champion in a sports competition
senses.pattern: win the title / defend the title / a world title / a national title
senses.example: The young swimmer won her first national [[title]] at the age of sixteen.
senses.example_zh: 這名年輕泳將十六歲時贏得她的第一個全國冠軍。

gsat.sentence: This was to ensure that no single and powerful noble family could seize the [[title]] and pass it to the next generation.

senses.en: to reach or pass a particular age or time
senses.pattern: turn 18 / turn thirty / have just turned sixty / it has just turned midnight
senses.example: My grandmother [[turns]] ninety next month, and the whole family is planning a surprise party.
senses.example_zh: 我奶奶下個月就滿九十歲了，全家人正在籌劃一場驚喜派對。
senses.note: 後面直接接年齡，不加 to

senses.en: a change in a situation or in the way something develops
senses.pattern: an unexpected turn / take a turn for the worse / the turn of the century
senses.example: The story takes an unexpected [[turn]] when the detective discovers a second letter.
senses.example_zh: 當偵探發現第二封信時，故事出現了意想不到的轉折。
senses.note: the turn of the century＝世紀之交

gsat.sentence: Some see it as a celebration related to the [[turn]] of the seasons from winter to spring; others, however, believe that it stems from the adoption of a new calendar.

senses.en: a large amount of something good or useful
senses.pattern: a wealth of information / a wealth of experience / a wealth of detail
senses.example: The museum's website offers a [[wealth]] of information about local history and wildlife.
senses.example_zh: 這座博物館的網站提供了大量關於當地歷史與野生動物的資訊。
senses.note: 固定用 a wealth of＋名詞

quiz.stem: Unlike traditional textbooks, this language app can be ______ to each learner's level and study goals, so no two users follow exactly the same lessons.
quiz.explain_zh: tailor＝量身打造、使適合。這個語言 App 能依每位學習者的程度與目標調整課程。

quiz.stem: Having coached young athletes for over thirty years, Mr. Chen brings a ______ of experience to the school's new basketball program.
quiz.explain_zh: wealth＝大量、豐富。陳教練為新的籃球計畫帶來三十多年的豐富經驗。

quiz.stem: Before putting all your savings into a new business, you should seek ______ financial advice from an expert rather than trust rumors online.
quiz.explain_zh: sound＝可靠的、明智的。創業投資前應向專家尋求可靠的理財建議。

quiz.stem: Although three classmates said they had seen him copying answers, Kevin still ______ that he had completed the test entirely on his own.
quiz.explain_zh: maintain＝堅稱。雖有同學指證他抄答案，凱文仍堅稱考卷是自己獨力完成的。

quiz.stem: The pianist's performance last night was ______ amazing; the audience stood and clapped for nearly five minutes after the final piece.
quiz.explain_zh: simply＝簡直、實在。鋼琴家的演出簡直太精采，觀眾起立鼓掌近五分鐘。

quiz.stem: The sudden closing of the town's only factory dealt a serious ______ to local families, many of whom had worked there for decades.
quiz.explain_zh: blow＝打擊、挫折。鎮上唯一的工廠突然關閉，對當地家庭是重大打擊。

quiz.stem: Researchers warn that findings from studies of adult learners do not always ______ true for young children, whose brains are still developing.
quiz.explain_zh: hold＝適用、成立。針對成人學習者的研究結果，未必適用於大腦仍在發育的幼童。

quiz.stem: Having relied on a smartphone since childhood, Amy admits that reading a paper map feels completely ______ to her.
quiz.explain_zh: foreign＝陌生的。從小依賴手機的艾咪，對看紙本地圖感到十分陌生。

quiz.stem: The proposal to start school an hour later has divided teachers into two ______: those who support it and those who fear a longer day.
quiz.explain_zh: camp＝陣營、派別。延後一小時上課的提案讓老師分成支持與反對兩個陣營。

quiz.stem: Because Jason handed in his science report three days late, the teacher ______ ten points from his final score.
quiz.explain_zh: dock＝扣減（分數）。傑森的報告遲交三天，老師從他的總成績扣了十分。
